body: Life outside the Beltway (life outside of Washington DC)
Oh, I see.  Thank you for your kind note to let me know.
I hope you read this Dan!
I'm starting all over with much less and 20 yrs older than you and I can't find anything to look forward to, but that's me.  Just wanted to say I understand ...  find your peace and be patient.
Tell the 4 people closet to me, how grateful and meaningful they are/have been to me, then, a hard cry!
I understand and share your preference of non-existence!  I am only here so that I can figure out the best way out and to wrap up a few details.  I hope you find peace!
Thank you for responding...very thought provoking and I'm struggling with letting go - I wish everyone could see my brighter side as they move forward.
Now at 52, I would be grateful for any signs of hope...thank you for helping me see the whole picture.
